subject: FY22 Budget Framework and Voting Process
overview: The committee reviewed the initial FY22 budget projections and discussed a new two-step voting procedure for the annual request. Members also approved the 2021-2022 school calendar and updated policies regarding professional staff job descriptions and student outreach.

items.title: Routine business
items.summary: Approved the April 12 minutes as well as bills, transfer of funds, and payroll.

items.title: Good of the Order
items.summary: The committee discussed adherence to Robert's Rules of Order and reached consensus on rotating questions to manage meeting length.

items.title: Behavioral Health and Special Education Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Approved a report detailing upcoming policy recommendations for mental health training and building friendship programs at the high school.

items.title: Public participation
items.summary: The committee received an email from a resident regarding the relevance of meeting topics and the display of the American flag during remote meetings.

items.title: Report of the Superintendent
items.summary: The Superintendent provided updates on Columbus School renaming, National Honor Society inductions, and the temporary suspension of Google Hangouts due to cyberbullying.

items.title: COVID-19 Public Health Update
items.summary: Health officials reported a school positivity rate of 0.06% and encouraged parents to vaccinate students aged 16 and older.

items.title: FY22 Budget Presentation
items.summary: The administration presented a projected budget increase range of $3.4 million to $5.8 million, highlighting fixed cost increases and a proposed two-step voting process to improve transparency.

items.title: Summer Fun and Community Schools
items.summary: The committee reviewed plans for summer programs, including a fee increase to $200 per week and the relocation of Summer Fun to the Columbus School.

items.title: 2021-2022 School Year Calendar
items.summary: Approved the academic calendar for the upcoming school year.

items.title: MBTA Bus Passes
items.summary: The administration reviewed the potential costs and equity implications of providing free or further discounted transit passes to all high school students.

items.title: Amended Policy GCA: Professional Staff Positions
items.summary: Approved an amended policy requiring the administration to publish and periodically review job descriptions for permanent staff starting October 1.

items.title: Mystic Valley NAACP Correspondence
items.summary: Entered a letter into the record from the NAACP supporting the removal of out-of-school suspensions and the renaming of the Columbus School.

items.title: Student Outreach Coordinator Designation
items.summary: Approved the designation of Dr. Peter Cushing as the Student Outreach Coordinator as required by state law.
